integrity: The all-order statement is proved combinatorially. Finite exhaustive checks through specified small orders are regression tests rather than substitutes for proof.
scientific_limitations: The structural theorem covers a single reversed arc of a transitive tournament only; the refined failure count concerns singleton valuations, not all valuations. Arbitrary tournaments and multiple arc reversals remain outside scope; historical priority is provisional.
title: The exact first-reversal stability spectrum of non-contingency introspection on tournaments
